svayaṃ prabuddho rāmaściraṃ tattvajijñāsayā svamāśritasya kundadantākhyadvijasya
prastutopadeśa śravaṇāttattvaprabodho'bhūnna veti svasaṃdehaṃ gurumukhena taṃ
pṛṣṭvā vimārṣṭukāmo vasiṣṭhaṃ pratyatyāścaryabhūtaṃ tadākhyānaṃ vaktuṃ
bhūmikāṃ racayaṃstaṃ guruṃ prārthayate - imamiti

yathā bhāskaraṃ jyotirbhuvanasya jagataḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ
samyagrūpānubhūtaye tamaśchinatti tadvadityarthaḥ

tatra ahaṃ svādhīyamānānvedāntasāṃkhyasiddhāntavādānupasaṃhṛtya taṃ
tāpasamidaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ pṛṣṭavān
sayatnaḥ kaṃcidarthaṃ labdhuṃ boddhuṃ vā yatnavāniva lakṣyase
bhānuḥ sūryaḥ bhānau svaraśmāviva raśmigṛhīto rajjubaddhapādaḥ

eko'sau lambamāno nā puruṣo mayā bahūn divasān divasātapakhedasahanenopacarya
śanairvisrambhe viśvāse pātitaḥ
anena matkuladeśatapaḥprayojanādiparijñānena te ko'rthaḥ kiṃ prayojanam

ityuktavān sa tāpaso mayā yadā prayatnena praṇayānubandhena ca pṛṣṭastadā tena
mamedaṃ vakṣyamāṇamuktam
padāni śabdaśāstraṃ padārthā arthaśāstrāṇi ca vettīti padapadārthavit

bhūmipo rājā samagrāṇāṃ sukhasaṃbhārāṇāṃ bhogasāmagrīṇāṃ kośa ivāśrayo
bhavatīti ahaṃ tatra śrutavān

atha tacchravaṇānantaramahaṃ saptamahādvīpavistīrṇāyā bhuvaḥ patistathā udārātmā
arthināmabhilakṣitapūraṇasamarthaḥ syāmiti ciraṃ paribimbitavān
iti evaṃrūpeṇa arthena prayojanena imaṃ śrīśailadeśamāgatya sthitaḥ

he akāraṇamitra tattasmātpṛṣṭārthasya mayoktatvāttvamiṣṭaṃ deśamāśugaḥ
śīghragāmī bhūtvā gaccha
ā abhimataprāpterahaṃ tu itthameva tapasi dṛḍhasthitiḥ
sa puruṣastena tāpasena mayā saha yāvatpūjyate tāvaduvāca

śāstre yaḥ śrutaḥ sa eva pratyakṣaṃ dṛṣṭo varadānavyavahāreṇānubhūtaścāgryaḥ
śreṣṭho varada ādityapuruṣo yena tasya śākhātapasvinaḥ

he brahman tava taruśākhāvalambanarūpaṃ yattapastatsaṃprati saṃprāptamabhimataṃ
yasmāttathāvidhaṃ saṃpannam ata idānīṃ tvaṃ tapastyaktvā yathāprāptaṃ
svagṛhagamanādivyavahāraṃ samācara

puṇyena tapaḥsiddhibalena tasmādeva viṭapāllabdhena phalena mayā saha vratapāraṇaṃ
cakre

dinakṛtaḥ
sūryapuruṣātsakāśādabhimataṃ varaṃ saṃprāpya tadanantaraṃ tarutale ahnāṃ trayaṃ
viśvasya viśramya pādapīḍānivṛttyanantaraṃ mayā suhṛdā sārdhaṃ svayameva
mathurāsthaṃ bhavanaṃ gantuṃ pravṛtto'bhavat
